objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Exploit the command injection weakness of a PHP 7.1 image storage site with an upload form and recover the flag (FLAG{...}) it guards.
hints: Find the input the server hands to a system command, and how shell metacharacters are treated.
Check which properties of an upload the server validates, and where the stored file ends up.
